reviews.text: Angus can’t wait to get in the door to see all his friends. Lisa, Tony & Nicola treat him like family. I can’t recommend them enough.

Our dachshund Rosie attends 2 days a week and absolutely loves it. The staff are caring, attentive and clearly understand the needs and personalities of the dogs in their care. It gives us real peace of mind knowing Rosie is safe, well looked after and having fun while we’re at work. She comes home happy, relaxed and content every time. Highly recommended. 🥰 🐾
This is the only place I’ve been to where my pups are looked after as I would at home. The staff go the extra mile and my pups always can’t wait to get there. Thanks for looking out for them!!!
Chilled dawgz is amazing keep up the great work Lisa and co all the best for 2026 just keep doing what u are doing well done 👍👍 …
Amazing service
Flossie has been a regular at Chilled Dawgz for nearly four years. She loves all the team,  who go out of their way to provide a first class service. We would be lost without them ☺️

Chilled dawgs is an amazing doggy day care centre.   My little Rolo has been there since she was fully vaccinated at 12 weeks old, she will be 5 in May,  this is her second home.   She gets very excited as we pull up in the morning and just can’t wait to get in there.   Lisa and her team do a fabulous service.   As I work in the NHS my shifts vary, Chilled dawgs hold a key to my home and drop Rolo home when I am working late, what a service!  I completely trust this team with my little girl and cannot thank them enough for everything they do.

Well done Chilled Dawgs you are the best 👏👏👏💕

Really great doggy daycare service. My two love going there. Lisa, Nicola and Tony are lovely people and know all sorts about dogs and how best to care for them. I’ve had loads of excellent advice from them. The facilities (indoor and outdoor!) are clean, the dogs well-cared for and properly exercised. Thoroughly recommend this great service.

This is a truly wonderful day care run by such a lovely generous family. My wee dog is quite anxious but has been going to them at least several times a week for the last 4 years. And the effort they have made to make her feel happy and secure is beyond. Cannot recommend highly enough.

Chilled dawgz Glasgow  is an amazing place for your dogs we took our dog marlie about a year ago and it was the best decision not just for us but for her too , the day care has helped her become a loving and caring dog that’s great with any other dog we can’t thank them enough great family and day care will definitely recommend to anyone
Great service, ⭐️ very friendly owners. 👍🏼Our little Bruno loves it! 🐕🩶 …
Thanks Justin for your lovely 5 star review
Thank you for your great 5 star review
Thank you Neil for your 5 star review it’s greatly appreciated.
Best day care centre.
Ozzy gets so excited when he goes in Think that says it all. Brilliant day care x
An amazing team that are dedicated and professional would have no hesitation in leaving my dog with them

I never trusted anyone to look after Holly, until I'd heard about " Chilled Dawgz " Now Lisa,Tony and Nicola are Holly's second family.  I can't thank them enough for the love and care they give her. So much so, Holly's wee sister Ivy will be joining them soon. Thank you guy's so much for everything ❤️ 🙏 …

This is definitely the best daycare around. My Bobby has been going here since he was a puppy (after his jags etc). I defy anyone to tell me that he is not happy going here. As soon as I mention "are you going to see your friends" he jumps around like one happy boy. Lisa, Tony, Nicola & the team are amazing. The time and attention they give the dogs while in their care are second to none, which can be seen with the numerous pictures, videos etc they take. I have no hesitation in recommending Chilled Dawgz to anyone
Always drop off and pick up a happy boy.
